description: Fetch a PhaseFolio methodology section's full content (rNPV model, backtest, PoS calibration, IRA framework, development paths, deal-term modelling, clinical stage normalization, evidence standards, network benchmarks, COGS benchmark, SG&A benchmark, tax benchmark, SEC EDGAR deal-term extraction). Designed for citation: each section has a stable URL and a methodology version identifier you can reference in analysis output.

section.description: Which methodology section to fetch. 'rnpv' covers the core risk-adjusted NPV calculation: cumulative PoS, midpoint-discounted risk-adjusted development costs, the S-curve ramp/plateau/LOE revenue lifecycle net of COGS/SG&A/tax, WACC discounting, the rNPV and Unadjusted-NPV equations, Monte Carlo / expected NPV, and one-at-a-time sensitivity; 'backtest' covers the validation methodology and AUC/CI numbers; 'pos-calibration' covers the indication × modality × biomarker matrix, expanded modality normalization into the eight benchmark baselines, the scored multipliers including the model 2.6.0 biomarker_quality drug-specific multiplier (oncology solid tumor, Phase II/III), the Phase 1 ORR extracted-but-not-scored signal with its Phase 0 governance disclosure, and the non-scored drug-specific risk flags; 'ira-framework' covers the Year-9/Year-13 MFP cliff modeling and the separate IRA classification for expanded modalities such as RNA Therapeutics, Protein Degrader, Radioligand, Oncolytic Virus, and Cancer Vaccine; 'development-paths' covers development-path tiers, automatic-effect policy, and the no path-based PoS/default-multiplier rule; 'deal-term-modelling' covers how licensing deal terms map onto a scenario's deal structure (term-model mapping v1): what is modelled, not modelled and refused, the territory restriction and the approximations it names, milestone timing at stage ends, the cost-share rule, and the non-USD conversion-rate refusal; 'stage-normalization' covers exact clinical labels, work packages, canonical PoS gates, and the no label-only PoS modifier rule for Phase 1b/2a/2b, adaptive, pivotal, expansion, platform, bridging, and related labels; 'evidence-standards' covers source tiers and freshness rules; 'network-benchmarks' covers anonymization and cohort cuts; 'cogs-benchmark' covers the per-modality COGS% default bands and price-sensitivity methodology; 'sga-benchmark' covers the per-commercial-model SG&A% default bands (orphan/specialty/primary-care); 'tax-benchmark' covers the US-statutory-21% default tax rate, effective-rate reality, and the NOL cap; 'sec-deal-terms' is the retirement notice for the SEC EDGAR deal-term source (retired 2026-09-27), with its frozen versions.

name: get_methodology

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

citation_url.description: Public canonical URL — cite this in analysis output.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last meaningful edit.

section_id.description: Stable section identifier — reuse as the citation key.

summary.description: Short summary suitable for inline quoting (≤500 chars).

version.description: Versioned identifier for this section's content, e.g. 'methodology@2026-04'.
